ranking: ascending structural-phase variance in measured static first 0.2 s; no truth or supplied SNR used
evaluation: same frame aperture times, same truth reference, same ADC/chirp and ADXL data for every target count
cold_start_note: Original algorithm is retained: one selected target starts at R=9 rad^2; two or more estimate each selected target R using residual from the selected-target median. R is recalibrated for each selected subset. Unselected targets do not initialize R. Hence this experiment includes original algorithm target-count-dependent initialization behavior.
std_definition: sample standard deviation across 20 independent seeds (ddof=1)
paired_improvement_definition: 100 * (RMSE_baseline - RMSE_current) / RMSE_baseline calculated within each seed, then summarized across seeds
simulation_boundary: A20 paper-parameterized displacement and target-domain IQ/noise with per-TX timing; no complete RF/ADC/PLL/multipath radar simulator
